justification: `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/maxicode/MaxiCodeReader.java` is the only production class in the package and it depends on `com.google.zxing.maxicode.decoder.Decoder` plus many `com.google.zxing`/`com.google.zxing.common` types; `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/MultiFormatReader.java` is the only production caller found and instantiates `new MaxiCodeReader()` in two branches; `docs/apidocs/com/google/zxing/maxicode/decoder/package-use.html` reports "No usage" for the decoder subpackage. So `com.google.zxing.maxicode` has low incoming coupling but depends on a less-stable, unused decoder package and several external core packages.
